user.title: Sign in to Carrier SmartHome
user.description: Uses Carrier's native GraphQL cloud API. Supports SmartHome entry-level thermostats only. Matter control is available separately after commissioning with a Matter Server. Your password is stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage for authentication and session renewal.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Carrier SmartHome
reauth_confirm.description: Your Carrier session needs to be reauthenticated.

error.invalid_auth: Carrier did not accept the credentials or login method.
error.cannot_connect: The Carrier SmartHome API could not be reached or returned an unexpected response.
error.no_devices: Login succeeded, but Carrier returned no entry-level thermostats for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Carrier account is already configured.

init.title: Choose thermostat
init.description: Select the Carrier thermostat whose controls you want to configure.

transport.title: Control connection
transport.description: Local Matter requires an already commissioned thermostat in an Open Home Foundation Matter Server. Verify the correct physical thermostat and keep its WebSocket endpoint restricted to your trusted LAN. Cloud only is always available. Confirm the Matter node belongs to the selected physical thermostat; VID/PID alone cannot prove that.

data.verified_same_device: I verified this Matter node is the selected physical thermostat

error.matter_not_ready: Matter Server did not confirm an online certified Carrier thermostat at this node and endpoint.
error.identity_not_verified: Confirm you have matched this node with the correct physical thermostat.

abort.no_devices: No Carrier thermostats are currently available for configuration.
